newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank rev repo minimum rate hits 102 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank rev repo minimum rate hits 102 pct.

text.p: The minimum rate at the Czech central bank's (CNB) reverse repo tender on Wednesday hit 102 percent, while the average rate was 105.92 percent, the CMN said in a statement.
It added that it accepted 56.47 percent of all bids at the minimum rate.

The central bank was forced to hold the reverse repo tender to add liquidity to the interbank money market to bring badly- needed funds to banks which must meet minimum reserve requirements on Wednesay.
On Tuesday the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR) rose to above 100 percent as banks scrambled to cover their positions.
